name: type:feature
description: New user-facing or developer-facing capability.

name: type:bug
description: Incorrect behavior, regression, runtime failure, or broken expectation.

name: type:docs
description: Documentation, guides, READMEs, examples, or comments.

name: type:refactor
description: Internal restructuring without intended behavior change.

name: type:chore
description: Maintenance that does not fit another type.

name: type:test
description: Unit, integration, e2e, fixture, or test infrastructure work.

name: type:ci
description: CI/CD, GitHub Actions, release automation, or build pipeline work.

name: type:deps
description: Dependency updates, lockfile changes, package manager maintenance.

name: type:release
description: Versioning, changelog, publishing, packaging, or release preparation.

name: type:security
description: Security fix, hardening, vulnerability remediation, or auth-related control.

name: area:frontend
description: Browser UI, React, Next.js, routing, client state, or frontend behavior.

name: area:backend
description: Server runtime, services, workers, controllers, or server-side business logic.

name: area:api
description: Public or internal API contracts, OpenAPI specs, clients, schemas, or endpoints.

name: area:data
description: Data models, databases, migrations, indexing, search, ETL, or persistence.

name: area:infra
description: Hosting, deployment, containers, networking, IaC, observability, or ops.

name: area:auth
description: Authentication, authorization, sessions, tokens, permissions, or identity.

name: area:ui
description: Styling, design system, accessibility, layout, components, or visual polish.

name: area:docs
description: Documentation site, generated docs, examples, API docs, or reference content.

name: area:cli
description: CLI commands, terminal UX, command parsing, local scripts, or developer tooling.

name: area:ai
description: LLMs, agents, RAG, evals, prompts, MCP, embeddings, or AI integrations.

name: priority:p0
description: Critical; blocks production, release, security, or core usage.

name: priority:p1
description: High priority; important and should be addressed soon.

name: priority:p2
description: Normal priority; valuable but not urgent.

name: priority:p3
description: Low priority; nice-to-have, cleanup, or opportunistic work.

name: size:xs
description: Trivial change; usually under 30 minutes or very small diff.

name: size:s
description: Small change; narrow scope and low review complexity.

name: size:m
description: Medium change; moderate scope, normal review effort.

name: size:l
description: Large change; broad scope, multiple files, or higher review burden.

name: size:xl
description: Very large change; should likely be split before merge.

name: risk:breaking
description: Breaking API, schema, behavior, CLI, config, or compatibility change.

name: risk:migration
description: Requires migration, backfill, deployment sequencing, or manual operator action.

name: risk:security
description: Affects security posture, secrets, permissions, auth, or sensitive data.

name: risk:performance
description: Meaningfully affects latency, throughput, memory, bundle size, or cost.

name: risk:experimental
description: Prototype, exploratory, unstable, or intentionally subject to change.

name: release:major
description: Candidate for a major version bump or breaking release notes.

name: release:minor
description: Candidate for a minor version bump or feature release notes.

name: release:patch
description: Candidate for a patch release, hotfix, or bugfix release notes.

name: release:blocker
description: Must be resolved before the next release can ship.

name: release:skip-notes
description: Does not need changelog or release note coverage.

name: status:needs-triage
description: Needs initial classification, priority, owner, or reproduction details.

name: status:needs-info
description: Waiting on more information before the work can proceed.

name: status:blocked
description: Blocked by dependency, decision, access, upstream issue, or external constraint.

name: status:ready
description: Ready to implement or review; no known blocker.

name: status:wontfix
description: Intentionally not planned or not appropriate for this repository.

name: good-first-issue
description: Small, well-contained task suitable for onboarding or a low-risk contribution.

name: help-wanted
description: External input, review, design feedback, or contribution would be useful.

name: question
description: Question, clarification, investigation, or open design discussion.

name: duplicate
description: Duplicate of another issue or PR.

name: invalid
description: Not reproducible, out of scope, malformed, or not actionable.
